verification.method: scripts/verify/poland.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100 (every year from 2022), rank 2026/2050/2100, share, growth, density, land area; 2023 peak and about half by 2100; third in Eastern Europe
More deaths than births every year since 2018; births and deaths 2026; births 1957 peak
Net migration 2021, 2022 (Poland's highest; second in Europe after Germany), outflows every year 2023–2026
Fertility under 2.1 since 1989, 2003 low, now; median age 2000/2026/2050; urban share second-lowest among European countries over 10 million after Romania
Title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 77 of 77 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
verification.result: All figures match. Comparisons name their size group and region; no causes are stated that the UN data do not show. No image alt text on the page (the flag and charts carry aria-labels).
